title: Boxlet design set (v2)
description: A portable Boxlet design: decisions, header and footer look, and optionally a composition, which makes it a character. Generated from the code that validates it; Boxlet's own validator decides. Keys left out of decisions take the neutral defaults. A key Boxlet does not know is left out with a warning.

seed.description: The main colour: buttons, links and the start of a gradient; the rest of the palette is worked out from it.

secondary.description: A second colour for contrast bands; without one, a deep shade of the main colour is used.

mode.description: Whether the page is light with dark words or dark with light words; every derived colour follows.

surface_contrast.description: How far the tinted surface and cards stand from the page, from none to strong. (number %, 0 – 100, step 1)

color_background.description: The page colour set by hand instead of worked out; the contrast check measures what is read on it.

color_card.description: A card's colour set by hand instead of half a step from the page.

color_surface.description: The tinted surface set by hand instead of a step from the page.

color_border.description: The colour of rules and outlines set by hand.

color_text.description: The text colour set by hand; it must read at 4.5:1 on the page, a card and the tinted surface.

color_muted.description: The quieter text (leads, captions, a card's lines) set by hand; it must read at 4.5:1 on the page, a card and the tinted surface.

color_link.description: The colour of links in running text, set by hand instead of the main colour.

page_background_colour.description: Any colour around a boxed page, instead of the one Around the page names.

header_colour.description: Any colour for the header bar, instead of its surface; its words are worked out from it.

footer_colour.description: Any colour for the footer, instead of its surface; its words are worked out from it.

heading_font.description: The family headings are set in, from the font library; its own weight, letter spacing, line height and capitals apply unless set.

body_font.description: The family running text is set in, from the font library; its own line height applies unless set.

text_size.description: The size of running text, in pixels; headings are measured from it by the scale. (number px, 14 – 20, step 0.5)

scale.description: How much larger each heading step is than the one below it. (number, 1.1 – 1.6, step 0.005)

line_height.description: The space between lines of running text, as a multiple of its size; '' takes the text family's. (number, 1.3 – 1.9, step 0.05)

heading_weight.description: How heavy headings are, the nearest weight the heading family has; '' takes the family's. (number, 300 – 900, step 100)

tracking.description: The space between a heading's letters, in em; '' takes the heading family's. (number em, -0.05 – 0.1, step 0.005)

caps.description: Whether headings are set in capitals; '' takes the heading family's.

nudge_h1.description: Pixels added to the largest heading after the scale has set it. (number px, -30 – 40, step 1)

nudge_h2.description: Pixels added to a section's heading after the scale has set it. (number px, -12 – 20, step 1)

nudge_sm.description: Pixels added to small print after the scale has set it. (number px, -3 – 5, step 1)

spacing.description: The unit every space inside a section is a multiple of, in rem. (number rem, 0.75 – 1.75, step 0.05)

section_gap.description: The room above and below each section, in pixels, unless a section sets its own. (number px, 32 – 160, step 4)

radius.description: The corners of cards, pictures and fields, in pixels. (number px, 0 – 32, step 1)

border_width.description: The width of every rule and outline, in pixels. (number px, 0 – 4, step 0.5)

shadow.description: How cards are lifted from the page: not at all, softly, with a hard offset edge, or in layers.

shadow_strength.description: How dark the shadow is, in percent. (number %, 0 – 100, step 1)

container.description: How wide the content runs on a large screen, in rem; narrow and wide sections are measured from it. (number rem, 36 – 88, step 2)

boxed.description: Whether the page is a sheet standing in a background of its own.

sheet_width.description: How wide the boxed sheet is, in rem. (number rem, 40 – 120, step 2)

frame.description: The room between a boxed sheet and the window's edge when the window is narrower than the sheet, in rem. (number rem, 0 – 6, step 0.25)

sheet_gap.description: The room above and below a boxed sheet, in steps of the spacing unit. (number, 0 – 8, step 1)

sheet_radius.description: The corners of a boxed sheet, in pixels. (number px, 0 – 32, step 1)

sheet_shadow.description: How a boxed sheet is lifted from its background: not at all, a shadow, or a hairline.

page_background.description: What stands around a boxed sheet: the tinted surface, the border colour, or the contrast colour.

header_bleed.description: Whether the header bar stays on a boxed sheet or runs the window's whole width.

header_width.description: What the header's contents line up with: the text, the sheet, or the window.

footer_bleed.description: Whether the footer bar stays on a boxed sheet or runs the window's whole width.

footer_width.description: What the footer's contents line up with: the text, the sheet, or the window.

button_style.description: How a button is drawn: filled with its colour, outlined in it, or a soft tint of it.

button_radius.description: A button's corners, in pixels; the largest values make a pill. (number px, 0 – 28, step 1)

button_height.description: A button's height, in pixels. (number px, 32 – 60, step 2)

button_caps.description: Whether a button's words are set in capitals.

dark.description: The set's dark version (D-185): in dark mode these stand for the light ones. A colour left out is worked out by the palette; anything else left out is the light version's. With it, both versions are checked for contrast.

seed.description: The main colour: buttons, links and the start of a gradient; the rest of the palette is worked out from it.

secondary.description: A second colour for contrast bands; without one, a deep shade of the main colour is used.

surface_contrast.description: How far the tinted surface and cards stand from the page, from none to strong. (number %, 0 – 100, step 1)

color_background.description: The page colour set by hand instead of worked out; the contrast check measures what is read on it.

color_card.description: A card's colour set by hand instead of half a step from the page.

color_surface.description: The tinted surface set by hand instead of a step from the page.

color_border.description: The colour of rules and outlines set by hand.

color_text.description: The text colour set by hand; it must read at 4.5:1 on the page, a card and the tinted surface.

color_muted.description: The quieter text (leads, captions, a card's lines) set by hand; it must read at 4.5:1 on the page, a card and the tinted surface.

color_link.description: The colour of links in running text, set by hand instead of the main colour.

header_colour.description: Any colour for the header bar, instead of its surface; its words are worked out from it.

footer_colour.description: Any colour for the footer, instead of its surface; its words are worked out from it.

shadow_strength.description: How dark the shadow is, in percent. (number %, 0 – 100, step 1)

look.description: '' or a choice left out follows the character.

header_arrangement.description: Where the logo, the menu and the button stand in the header.

header_behaviour.description: Whether the header scrolls away, stays at the top, or lies over the first section.

header_opacity.description: How solid the header's background is, in percent, when it is sticky or lies over the first section. (number %, 0 – 100, step 1)

header_blur.description: How much the page under a see-through header is blurred, in pixels. (number px, 0 – 24, step 1)

header_surface.description: The header's background: plain, tinted, contrast or gradient.

header_edge.description: What divides the header from the page: nothing, a line, or a shadow.

header_height.description: The header's height on a large screen, in pixels. (number px, 48 – 120, step 2)

logo_size.description: The logo's height, in pixels. (number px, 20 – 72, step 1)

brand.description: Whether the header shows the logo, the site's name, or both.

nav_style.description: How the menu's items are drawn: plain, in capitals, as pills, on a bar, or as chips.

nav_ink.description: Whether the menu's words take the main colour or the text colour.

header_button.description: How the header's button is drawn, or none.

footer_layout.description: How the footer is arranged: one column, centred, two columns, the menu first, or three columns.

footer_columns.description: How a long menu in a footer column is listed when the footer is in columns: 2 one list, 3 two lists side by side, 4 three.

footer_links.description: Whether a column's menu follows the arrangement or stands one item under another.

small_print_row.description: How the last row is laid out: stacked, split to both sides, or centred.

footer_surface.description: The footer's background: plain, tinted, contrast or gradient.

footer_edge.description: What divides the footer from the page above it: nothing, a line, a slant or a curve.

patterns.description: Starter sections, the one place a set carries words: per language ({"en": …, "hr": …}, or one string), English the fallback. No pictures, files or forms. The first 12 are read.

composition.description: Present: the set can be a character. Block types this site does not have, and layouts a block does not offer, are left out with a warning.

surface.description: The band's background: the page, the tinted surface, the contrast colour, a picture under a veil of it, or the gradient.

width.description: How wide the band's content runs: narrow (two thirds of the content width), normal, wide (seven sixths), or the window's.

align.description: Whether the band's content stands at the start or in the middle.

divider.description: What divides the band from the one above: nothing, a line, a slant or a curve.

v_align.description: Where the content stands in a band taller than it: top, middle or bottom.

animation.description: How the band's content arrives as it scrolls into view; never for a visitor who asked for less motion.

pad_top.description: The room above the content, in pixels; '' is the design's section gap. (number px, 0 – 200, step 4)

pad_bottom.description: The room below the content, in pixels; '' is the design's section gap. (number px, 0 – 200, step 4)

min_height.description: The band's least height, in percent of the window; 0 is as tall as its content. (number %, 0 – 100, step 5)
